import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Select numerical columns for correlation analysis
numerical_cols = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                  'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 
                  'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']

# Compute correlation matrix
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()

# Create heatmap
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            linewidths=0.5, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
plt.title('Correlation Matrix of Sleep Health Metrics', fontsize=16, pad=20)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.yticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the visualization
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Select numerical columns for correlation analysis
numerical_cols = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                  'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 
                  'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']

# Compute correlation matrix
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()

# Create heatmap
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            linewidths=0.5, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
plt.title('Correlation Matrix of Sleep Health Metrics', fontsize=16, pad=20)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.yticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the visualization
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
